source: SL_kza, platform 8.3.15.1489, 2026-10-17, through the mcp_APIBackend server: "platform" = validate_query (СхемаЗапроса); nothing was executed. "designerApplied" = this product's Designer open → Apply (preserve mode, no metadata) on branch feat/c2-bilingual-tokens, each generated text then validated on the platform.
verdict: C2: the platform reads one bilingual word table. English keywords, functions, period words and metadata names are accepted, mixed freely with Russian; the canonical text (СхемаЗапроса) is Russian, aliases and names inside ЗНАЧЕНИЕ()/ТИП() are kept as written. Words reserved as an alias are the same in both languages (`КАК From` is rejected like `AS ИЗ`). A word written right after `.` is a name in either language (`E.Order`, `ВТ.Упорядочить`).
notes: Failures in the metadataNames and russianControls groups come from objects or attributes absent in SL_kza (the Russian controls fail the same way), not from the language. GROUPING SETS / ГРУППИРУЮЩИМ НАБОРАМ and the newer string functions are rejected in both languages on 8.3.15.
